data.description: Mingda Absensi is an enterprise mobile application designed to streamline employee attendance and administrative operations. The app provides comprehensive features for automated attendance check-ins, leave and permission requests, and attendance records integrated directly with the corporate backend. Adapted from the existing web platform with responsive mobile UI/UX, the application delivers a seamless, practical attendance management experience on mobile devices.

MiERP is a Flutter-based enterprise resource planning (ERP) mobile application designed to streamline internal business workflows. The platform features two core user roles: Finance for transaction authorization and fiscal oversight, and Warehouse for real-time inventory management, stock tracking, and purchase order fulfillment. Engineered with clean architecture and Firebase cloud integration, MiERP boosts operational efficiency, mitigates logistical bottlenecks, and guarantees fast, accurate, and transparent business operations.

Policili is a Flutter-powered smart agriculture mobile system developed to help farmers select optimal companion crops for chili polyculture cultivation. Integrated with custom IoT telemetry hardware, the system gathers real-time soil and ambient parameters including soil pH, temperature, soil moisture, and atmospheric humidity. These sensor data streams are evaluated through a machine learning classifier to deliver scientifically backed companion planting recommendations tailored specifically to the user's field conditions.

Alongside intelligent recommendations, Policili provides secure user authentication, historical analytics records, and personalized account configuration. Combining embedded IoT systems with a sleek Flutter interface, Policili delivers a smart, practical solution to sustainably maximize polyculture crop yields.

VAS Mobile is an enterprise-grade Android application developed with Flutter, functioning as a complete Document Management System (DMS) equipped with digital stamping (e-Materai), cryptographic e-Signatures, and official digital verification seals. Built to facilitate compliant and secure administrative procedures on mobile devices, VAS Mobile accelerates paperless digital governance while ensuring legal non-repudiation and document authenticity. The solution incorporates role-based authorization, end-to-end document tracking, transaction histories, and user profile management, delivering a robust, trusted platform for modern corporate operations.
Scantivo is an intelligent mobile scanning and document recognition application built with Flutter, designed for fast edge-device OCR, multi-page document organization, and clean cloud export.
